flows.name: Missing selected-project context
steps: Open the global AI assistant without selecting a project
Ask a question about this project or this job
flows.expectedOutcome: Both turns stop before retrieval and instruct the user to select a project

flows.name: Selected-project meeting scope
steps: Open the global assistant project picker
flows.expectedOutcome: The composer and trace carry the exact selected project ID, the resend uses the canonical recent-meetings reader, and no unrelated project evidence is substituted

checks: Project options render above the fixed widget panel
The selected project is exposed in accessible composer state
No new wrapper panel, duplicate action, or visual filler is introduced

claims.description: Project-relative requests with no selected project stop before source retrieval
A selected project ID survives through retrieval and trace
The global widget project picker accepts pointer selection on desktop and mobile
Aliases, contextual follow-ups, scope-stop recovery, fresh-topic resets, and mixed-source research have durable regression tests
